newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity to start trading at 1330 GMT.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity to start trading at 1330 GMT.

text.p: Shares in newly merged Anglo-U.S. group LucasVarity Plc are due to start trading on Friday at 1330 GMT. The new company will be one of the top ten automotive component suppliers in the world, with annual sales of about 4.4 billion stg.
The market capitalisation of the group is expected to be around 3.2 billion stg and LucasVarity is likely to be included in the FTSE 100 after the quarterly review of the index on September 11.
Lucas Industies Plc's merger with Varity Corp was approved by both sets of shareholders in August.
Varity's shares will be delisted from the S&P 500 in the U.S. simultaneously with the start of trading in LucasVarity.
